comment.description:
Gp_EcuStpShdn startup.
this function will realize multi-core timing controlling. invoke microcontroller PreRun test function
and check test result, and process test failed situation. get reset information from Gp_RstM,
check safe state flag and try power shutdown flag, the program will enter the corresponding state if the flag is set,
else, the program will invoke MCAL initialization function and check initialization result,
and process initialization failed situation. invoke SBC self test function and check test result,
and process test failed situation. this function will record several system time of startup key point for observing.

sequences.name: Initialization（主核 Core0）
sequences.diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant OS as OS
    participant EcuStpShdn as Gp_EcuStpShdn
    participant RstM as Gp_RstM
    participant TstApp as Gp_TstApp

    OS->>EcuStpShdn: Gp_EcuStpShdn_Startup()
    EcuStpShdn->>EcuStpShdn: Gp_EcuStpShdn_CalloutGetCoreId()
    EcuStpShdn->>EcuStpShdn: Gp_EcuStpShdn_CalloutInitStageOneCore0()
    opt GP_RSTM_PROJ_TYPE_SEL 生效时
        EcuStpShdn->>RstM: Gp_RstM_InitOne()
    end
    opt GP_ECUSTPSHDN_SAFETY_ENABLE 生效时
        EcuStpShdn->>TstApp: Gp_TstApp_PreRunInit()
        EcuStpShdn->>TstApp: Gp_TstApp_PreRunPhase()
    end
    EcuStpShdn->>EcuStpShdn: Gp_EcuStpShdn_CalloutGetSysTimeMs()
    alt GP_RSTM_PROJ_TYPE_SEL 生效时
        EcuStpShdn->>RstM: Gp_RstM_InitTwo()
    else 未生效时
        EcuStpShdn->>RstM: Gp_RstM_Init()
    end
    alt MstImpl_ptst->TryPwrShdn_b == TRUE
        opt GP_ECUSTPSHDN_SAFETY_ENABLE 生效时
            opt GP_ECUSTPSHDN_SAFETY_ACTION_ENABLE 生效时
                EcuStpShdn->>EcuStpShdn: Gp_EcuStpShdn_CalloutPwrShdnInStpPhase()
            end
        end
    else MstImpl_ptst->SafeState_b == TRUE
        opt GP_ECUSTPSHDN_SAFETY_ENABLE 生效时
            opt GP_ECUSTPSHDN_SAFETY_ACTION_ENABLE 生效时
                EcuStpShdn->>EcuStpShdn: StpStageTwo_pf()
                EcuStpShdn->>EcuStpShdn: Gp_EcuStpShdn_CalloutSbcInitInSafeState()
                EcuStpShdn->>EcuStpShdn: Gp_EcuStpShdn_CalloutSafeState()
            end
        end
    else
        opt GP_ECUSTPSHDN_SAFETY_ENABLE 生效时
            EcuStpShdn->>EcuStpShdn: Gp_EcuStpShdn_MstProcMcuPreRunTest()
        end
        EcuStpShdn->>EcuStpShdn: StpStageTwo_pf()
        EcuStpShdn->>EcuStpShdn: Gp_EcuStpShdn_CalloutGetSysTimeMs()
        opt GP_ECUSTPSHDN_SAFETY_ENABLE 生效时
            EcuStpShdn->>EcuStpShdn: Gp_EcuStpShdn_MstPostInit()
        end
        EcuStpShdn->>EcuStpShdn: Gp_EcuStpShdn_CalloutSbcInit()
        EcuStpShdn->>EcuStpShdn: Gp_EcuStpShdn_CalloutGetSysTimeMs()
    end

OS 触发入口函数后共发出 18 条调用消息，涉及外部模块 Gp_RstM、Gp_TstApp。

sequences.diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant OS as OS
    participant EcuStpShdn as Gp_EcuStpShdn

        EcuStpShdn->>EcuStpShdn: GP_ECUSTPSHDN_NOP()
    end
    EcuStpShdn->>EcuStpShdn: StpStageTwo_pf()
    EcuStpShdn->>EcuStpShdn: Gp_EcuStpShdn_CalloutGetSysTimeMs()
    opt GP_ECUSTPSHDN_SAFETY_ENABLE 生效时

                end
            end
        end
    end
